note: Text mode shows each place as an illustration (a still rendered from the real 3D scene) with this description, then the same pre-task, dialogue choices, feedback and phrasebook as 3D mode. NPC reactions are written out in words.

station.title: Harbour Central station (fictional)
station.alt: A station concourse under a glass roof. In front: a red ticket machine showing CARD NOT ACCEPTED, a blue help desk with a staff member, and a departures board listing the 10:15 to Seaview from platform 4.

cafe.title: Harbour Café (fictional)
cafe.alt: A warm café counter with a coffee machine, a glass cake display and a large menu board. The vegetable curry is crossed out as sold out; the pesto pasta and Harbour salad are marked as containing nuts.

pharmacy.title: Harbour Pharmacy (fictional)
pharmacy.alt: A bright pharmacy counter with a green PHARMACY sign and shelves of plain boxes. The pharmacist stands behind the counter. A yellow box of fictional honey and lemon lozenges shows the instructions: one every three hours, no more than six in 24 hours.

hostel.title: Harbour Hostel (fictional)
hostel.alt: A hostel reception in a bright lobby with a green wall. A receptionist stands behind a wooden desk with a bell and a screen that reads NO BOOKING for tonight. A sign lists room prices and says private rooms are full tonight.
